summary.request: Each service contract line gets a Billing Category. Contract invoices created by the Create Contract Invoices batch must show the category on every invoice line and on the posted service invoice lines, and finance wants to filter service ledger entries by it. Also, every service order line should show the Asset Class of the service item it belongs to, and we need the Asset Class on item ledger entries for parts consumed on service orders.
summary.business-process: Adds a contract-line Billing Category carried by Create Contract Invoices (ServContractManagement) to contract service ledger entries, invoice service lines and posted service invoice lines, and an Asset Class carried from service items through service order lines and service posting to item ledger entries, in Service Management.

data-flow.note: Entered on the contract lines page.

At invoice creation by Create Contract Invoices (CreateAllServLines -> CreateServiceLedgEntry), on all three insert points: not prepaid, prepaid per month, prepaid partial period. Read the contract line parameter, not the header.

In ServLedgEntryToServiceLine, copy from ServiceLedgerEntryParm (the entry being converted), never from the global ServiceLedgerEntry parameter. Lines, not the header, carry the value, so Combine Invoices keeps each contract's category.

Serv-Documents Mgt. at posting; same field number, type and length on both tables. No subscriber. Posting closes the existing contract service ledger entries with ModifyAll, so their Billing Category stays.
SetServItemInfo, called when Service Item No. is validated.
Validation of Service Item Line No. on the service line; validating Service Item No. on an order line goes through the same validation.
Serv-Posting Journals Mgt. builds the item journal line with Service Line.CopyToItemJnlLine for shipped and consumed items.
Item Jnl.-Post Line initializes the entry before insert; journal lines from other sources leave it empty.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Billing Category from the contract line to the contract service ledger entry for contracts that are not prepaid.
Copy Billing Category to each monthly entry of a prepaid contract.
guards: Read the contract line, not ServiceContractHeader, which is only filled for a partial month.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Billing Category to the prepaid partial-period entry.
Copy Billing Category from the converted contract service ledger entry to the contract invoice service line.
guards: Read ServiceLedgerEntryParm, not the parameter named ServiceLedgerEntry (the codeunit's global, last-created entry).

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Asset Class from the service item to the service item line.
Copy Asset Class from the service item line the service line belongs to.
guards: Take the value from the ServItemLine parameter; never guess the service item from the order, which can service several items.

subscriptions.purpose: Copy Asset Class from the service line to the item journal line built at service posting.
Copy Asset Class from the item journal line to the new item ledger entry before insert.
guards: Copy from the item journal line only; do not re-read the service item or service order here.

lifecycle.step: Set DataClassification on every field the table extensions add (CustomerContent for the Billing Category and Asset Class codes); a tableextension has no table-level value to inherit.

No InitValue is used, so no upgrade code is needed for new rows; existing contract lines, service items, open service lines and posted history stay blank. Back-fill only if question backfill-existing-data asks for it.
If back-fill is chosen, run it once per company behind its own upgrade tag (HasUpgradeTag / SetUpgradeTag), not a version check.
Put the ToolTip on the table fields so bound page fields inherit it (applies from BC24 / runtime 13.0; on earlier runtimes add page-level ToolTips).

No new table is created, so no permission set change is needed for table extensions and subscriber codeunits; if Billing Category or Asset Class becomes a new master table (questions billing-category-definition, asset-class-source), add it with its pages to the app's permission sets.

tests.given: A signed, not prepaid service contract (created with the Library codeunits) with two lines carrying different Billing Categories
tests.when: Create Contract Invoices runs for the contract (request page handled by a handler)
tests.then: Each contract service ledger entry and each invoice service line built from it carries its own contract line's Billing Category

tests.given: A prepaid contract invoiced over several months with a Billing Category on its line
tests.then: Every monthly contract service ledger entry and every resulting service line carries the Billing Category

tests.given: A prepaid contract whose invoice period produces a partial-period entry
tests.then: The partial-period service ledger entry and its service line carry the Billing Category

tests.given: One contract with several lines and different Billing Categories, so several entries are converted into lines in one run
tests.then: No line carries the value of the last-created entry; each line matches the entry in its Appl.-to Service Entry

tests.given: Two contracts for the same bill-to customer with different Billing Categories
tests.when: Create Contract Invoices runs with Combine Invoices
tests.then: The single invoice's lines carry each contract's own Billing Category

tests.given: A contract invoice created by Create Contract Invoices with Billing Category on its lines
tests.then: Each Service Invoice Line carries the Billing Category, and filtering Service Ledger Entry by Billing Category returns the closed contract entries of that invoice

tests.given: A service item with an Asset Class and a service order with a service item line for it
tests.when: A service line is added under that service item line
tests.then: The service item line and the service line show the service item's Asset Class

tests.given: A service order servicing two service items with different Asset Classes
tests.when: Service lines are added under each service item line
tests.then: Each service line carries the Asset Class of its own service item line

tests.given: A service order line of type Item under a service item with an Asset Class
tests.when: The order is posted with Ship and Consume
tests.then: The item ledger entry for the consumed part carries the Asset Class

tests.given: An item journal line not created from a service line
tests.then: The item ledger entry's Asset Class is empty

open-questions.question: What is a Billing Category: a code from a new master table (with its own page and permissions), an enum, or free text? This sets the field type, length and TableRelation on every table that holds it.

Is the Asset Class an existing field (for example from another app or a fixed-asset class) or a new field on Service Item maintained by users? This sets its type, length and whether the Service Item Card extension is needed.

Must contract credit memos (built by CreateCreditLine) and posted Service Cr.Memo Lines also carry the Billing Category? That needs a subscriber to OnBeforeServLineInsert and a mirrored field on Service Cr.Memo Line.

Contract invoices also contain text lines (heading, detailed and last lines) that are not built from a service ledger entry. Should they stay blank, or does 'every invoice line' include them? No BCQuality article names an event for those lines.

Only contract service ledger entries will carry the Billing Category. Should service ledger entries from service orders, invoices and credit memos posted against a contract (usage, sale, credit memo paths in ServLedgEntries-Post) carry one too, and from which source?
Are both prepaid and non-prepaid contracts in scope? The design covers all three entry insert points; any that never applies can be dropped.
Should service invoices and credit memos entered directly (no service item line) also show the Asset Class? That needs a copy from Service Item when Service Line.Service Item No. is validated.
Should the Asset Class also reach posted service shipment, invoice and credit memo lines? Each needs a mirrored field with the same number, type and length.
Service posting writes item ledger entries both when parts are shipped and when they are consumed. Should the Asset Class be on both, or only on consumption entries?
Will users see or filter the Asset Class as a column on Item Ledger Entries? If not, a related table keyed by Entry No. is preferred over a stored field on this hot ledger.
Should existing contract lines, open contract service ledger entries, service items or open service orders be back-filled on upgrade, or is blank acceptable for history?
Should the Billing Category carry from service contract quotes to the signed contract, and to filed (archived) contracts? No BCQuality article covers those copies.
